title: The sign, photographed
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Tourists photograph the Lanes' sign from the highway shoulder. All fifteen letters. Wood watches from across the road. A tourist asks him if it's famous. He says not yet. The tourist asks when. He says he'll let them know.

panels.composition: 101 by the bowling alley, day. Two TOURISTS on the shoulder photographing the sign, all fifteen letters. WOOD across the road with BARNABY.
